name: Generate identity candidates
criteria: Existing media file with its type and SHA-256 recorded
Generation event declared with tool, responsible actor, and date
Preserve the selected original concept, personality, recognition anchors, and chosen level of realism or stylization

Use verified Higgsfield character/image capabilities by default, independently of the coordinating assistant; integrated assistant images require an explicit user choice, and unavailable capability remains pending with alternatives proposed

Execution follows the observed method plan for each stage and records method, actual tool, provider/module/access route where applicable, exposed model, prompts, exact input/output files and hashes, known costs, and limitations
Candidates and an in-character scene express the selected personality and premise; coherent reference development follows the user's visual selection
Reference files are actually attached to later generation/editing calls and recorded with their hashes; mentioning paths in a prompt does not attach them

Verify the selected module separately: Builder character sheets do not establish Soul Cinema, identity training, voice, video, or export capability; account limits and applicable paid-generation authorization apply
Required identity/reference stages have actual evidence; unavailable stages remain pending without silent substitution or omission
Preserve any existing approved identity and references; changing a requested method requires an explicit user decision and recorded replanning
Does not approve identity or publish
